from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityMetrics(BaseModel):
    """Raw metrics extracted from a single university's Common Data Set report for the Holistic Performance Score task."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university")
    graduation_rate: float | None = Field(description="Six-year graduation rate value")
    graduation_cohort: str | None = Field(description="The cohort associated with the graduation rate (e.g. 'Fall 2015')")
    total_applicants: float | None = Field(description="Total number of applicants")
    admitted_students: float | None = Field(description="Number of students admitted")
    enrolled_students: float | None = Field(description="Number of enrolled students")
    admission_cycle: str | None = Field(description="The admission cycle associated with the data (e.g. 'Fall 2021')")
    student_faculty_ratio: float | None = Field(description="Student-to-faculty ratio")
    sf_ratio_cycle: str | None = Field(description="The cycle associated with the student-to-faculty ratio")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityMetrics]
